instruction: Open the 2022 book reading spreadsheet on the desktop. Find the book with the second-slowest reading speed (second-lowest words per day). Write its title to 'book_list_result.docx' on the desktop.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);
